yes.description: Answer yes to any questions instead of prompting.

execute.description: Execute the notebook prior to export.

allow_errors.description: Continue notebook execution even if one of the cells throws an error.

stdout.description: Write notebook output to stdout instead of files.

log_level.description: Set the log level by value or name. Choices: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, CRITICAL.

inplace.description: Run nbconvert in place, overwriting the existing notebook.

nbformat.description: The nbformat version to write. Choices: 1, 2, 3, 4.

writer.description: Writer class used to write the results of the conversion.

to.description: The export format to be used. Choices: custom, html, latex, markdown, notebook, pdf, python, rst, script, slides.

template.description: Name of the template file to use.

output.description: Overwrite base name use for output files.

post.description: PostProcessor class used to write the results of the conversion.

config_file.description: Full path of a config file. Used to reference this config.

notebooks.description: List of notebook files to convert. Only relevant if not passed on command line.
